theorems.name: Submission.dph_iprod_slice_continuity
theorems.statement: (∀ (m k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k), X.mass < ∞ → ∀ (η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (k + 1)) (φ : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k), (∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ (x : Eucl m) (v : Fin k → Eucl m), (φ s : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) k) x v = (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (k + 1)) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → ContinuousOn (fun s => X (φ s)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧ ∀ C : ℝ, (∀ y, covectorEuclideanNorm ((η : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (k + 1)) y) ≤ C) → ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, |X (φ s)| ≤ X.mass.toReal * C) ∧ (∀ (m q : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) q), X.mass < ∞ → ∀ (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) q) (Ψ : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) q), Continuous ω → HasCompactSupport ω → (∀ (s : ℝ) (x : Eucl m) (v : Fin q → Eucl m), (Ψ s : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) q) x v = ω ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x))) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → Continuous (fun s => X (Ψ s)) ∧ ∀ C : ℝ, (∀ y, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω y) ≤ C) → ∀ s : ℝ, |X (Ψ s)| ≤ X.mass.toReal * C)
